title: Chapter 24 A Lot Of Gold Coins
content:
Chapter 24 A Lot Of Gold Coins

He silently calculated that if all the items listed by Wang Shuo in the trading house were sold, they would cost a terrifying 700 gold coins.

"The strength of the boss is so terrifying!"

At this time, the players in the chat channel were also in a frenzy.

"Damn, there are so many weapons, I really want them!"

"Why is it so expensive? My total assets now are only 15 silver coins. I originally thought I was okay, but I didn't expect that I can't even afford ordinary quality equipment."

"I bought a set of bows, arrows, weapons, and armor. I feel like I can do it again. I will eat wild boar tomorrow."

"Boss, I really want to be your little brother!"

…

Wang Shuo's private chat messages and requests to add friends instantly reached 99+.

At this time, Wang Shuo, who was sleeping, did not know about the chat channel.

In the morning, Wang Shuo was woken up by the cold again.

Because he forgot to add firewood to the kang yesterday, the fire in the morning had been extinguished.

Fortunately, it went out soon, otherwise he might freeze to death.

I checked the system time, it was 7:03 in the morning.

There were snowflakes outside, and the front yard that Wang Shuo had not yet had time to build was already covered in snow.

Snowflakes flying all over the sky caused the temperature to plummet, keeping countless players awake all night.

Even though they kept adding wood to the campfire, they still couldn't let them sleep peacefully.

The warmth of the wooden house was too poor, the temperature was lost too quickly, and they lacked enough warm cotton clothing. Even when they stood next to the fire, their hands and feet were cold.

As a last resort, they had to constantly adjust the position of the fire, baking the front for a while and the back for a while.

Just like fried tofu, this is called "two-sided yellow".

Moreover, the extremely cold weather also accelerated the consumption of wood, and they fell into an embarrassing situation of shortage of wood.

Many players no longer complained in the [Chat Channel], begged their father, or sued their grandma.

They would rather keep their dignity and die quietly!

Li Xiaomeng was already in despair. Looking at the bonfire in front of him, there was still the last piece of wood in his backpack, with tears shining in his eyes.

She has never played this kind of game, so she lags behind others in everything. Moreover, she has very little strength, and her speed in collecting resources is much slower than others.

Looking at the pet cat beside her, she took out a piece of meat and handed it over.

"Meow!"

Miserable, miserable, miserable, how can the word miserable be used?

She could only watch when she saw others exchanging various life-saving supplies. She only had a few copper coins in total.

This is probably the scene where "the wine and meat of the wealthy family smells bad, and the road freezes to death".

She put the last piece of wood into the bonfire.

"That's it! Maybe this is the best destination."

…

At the same time, Wang Shuo also relit the fire kang. Feeling that the temperature in the room was too low, he made another fire pit. After a while, his whole body warmed up.

Went to the kitchen and made myself some egg noodles.

Only then did he start browsing the information in the "Survivor's Manual".

First is [Task].

(Day 6, 7:36 am, number of survivors in the current area: 3147/10000.)

There are almost 1,000 fewer people, and Wang Shuo's noodles are no longer tasty!

[Main Mission]: Survive to the end.

[Side mission]

1. Please upgrade your residence to a courtyard house as soon as possible.

(Upgrade condition 1: 2000 wood + 10,000 fire bricks + 20,000 green tiles + 2,000 stone + 20 energy crystals + 200 iron ore + 100 gold coins + energy converter.)

(Upgrade condition 2: Complete control of the territory.)

2. Collect more supplies, build more buildings, make more tools, upgrade higher-level shelters,... to obtain a higher ranking.

3. Because you killed the elite crocodile, gained the hatred of the crocodile clan, slaughtered the sludge monster clan, and gained the hostility of the sludge monster leader, they decided to unite with the devil frog clan in the territory to launch a joint siege operation against you.

"Fuck, it won't happen!"

I'm just one person, and you three races are jointly acting together?

Wang Shuo was a little panicked. They were fighting in a group!

With an uneasy feeling, he checked the [Transaction].

At this time, he saw that almost all the items he had consigned were sold out.

He quickly checked the number of gold coins in the [backpack] - 782.

He felt like he was going to be knocked unconscious by gold coins.

Yesterday I was still chatting with Lao Zhang. If you have 10 gold coins, you are considered a rich man. Now this...

Wang Shuo's shock was not much different from Tang Hua's. Although he had psychological expectations when he listed the trading house, he never dared to think that these could be sold.

From this point of view, players who are living well have strong purchasing power.

At this moment, Wang Shuo thought, could gold coins be forged into gold ingots?

He quickly came to the furnace and tried to put a gold coin in, and found that it could be smelted.

[1 gold ingot = 10 gold coins]

Wang Shuo finally saw the hope of making a golden armored warrior.

100 gold ingots, and 500 iron ingots.

What Wang Shuo never dared to think about before, now he finally has hope.

However, the poor materials are also disappointing.

No matter how difficult it is, we must get it together.

Wang Shuo had a headache when he thought of the three tribes joining forces to suppress the enemy, and he had to find helpers.

The golden armored warrior produced at such a huge cost should have good combat power.

However, we still have 300 gold coins left, so we need to sell something!

Wang Shuo thought that he had opened a bronze treasure chest and got a lot of gold coins. If other players also opened their treasure chests, they would always get gold coins, so they could buy more supplies.

So he took out another 100 keys and hung them in the trading house.

At about 9 o'clock in the morning, the snow finally subsided.

At this time, Duan Wenxi, who had exchanged the water purifier blueprints from Wang Shuo, sent him a message.

"Boss, I have a few very good blueprints, which are very suitable for your civil engineering department."

"When did I become a civil engineering department?" Wang Shuo was a little puzzled.

"Haha, boss, look at you, you have occupied more than half of the tiles in the trading house."

"Everyone is now wondering if you are studying this major, otherwise how can you make so many tiles."

"You said so! What good blueprints do you have!"

"Wall construction blueprints, brick kiln construction blueprints."

Wang Shuo's eyes were straight, this must be a good thing for him! The blueprints that perfectly match his secondary profession.

"How did you get them?" Wang Shuo asked calmly, his tone was very flat, he was a little afraid that the other party would ask for too much.

Duan Wenxi smiled and said, "This is also thanks to the boss. I bought a bronze key and opened a treasure chest to get it."

So that's how it is. Wang Shuo plans to visit the trading house more often in the future. There must be many people who open treasure chests and get a lot of good things.

"What do you plan to exchange with me, gold coins or materials?"

"I won't exchange these two blueprints for anything, I'll give them to you."

Wang Shuo became alert.

"For free? Why?"

"A while ago, the water purifier blueprint you exchanged for me finally helped me out of the predicament. I can still make a living now, but this game is changing rapidly, and no one knows what will happen next?"

At this point, Duan Wenxi paused and continued, "I hope that you will help me when I encounter difficulties in the future. These two blueprints are considered a favor."

Duan Wenxi has been paying attention to Wang Shuo for some time and knows what was posted in the trading house yesterday.

He was completely shocked, and more determined to cling to this thigh.

He even thought that Wang Shuo should be the most powerful one at present. If not the first, he could at least be ranked in the top three.

When Wang Shuo heard this, he stood there in a daze.
